commands.segment: uv run --project native python -m pytest native/tests/readers -q

commands.note: whole native suite: 52 collected, 52 passed (contracts + boundary + readers)
unchanged Python suites; confirms no regression at the root

environment.note: Native stack executed through the frozen uv lock delivered by T02; no dependency was added or altered.

limitations: F10/F11 exist as in-test synthesized mechanisms (missing ToUnicode passthrough; four-position duplicate runs) because the fixture families are still 'specified' in the catalog; generation of committed F10/F11 fixture files belongs to the fixture owner, requested below.
Char-level iteration follows PDFium's UTF-16 code-unit indexing; supplementary-plane scalar handling is exercised by later native-unicode families (F14), not asserted here.
Render capability is declared 'unavailable' in the PDFium manifest until the render-scale compensation is proven under the OCR/render tasks (T27/T28).
In-process adapters only: child-process supervision, backpressure acknowledgment and atomic partial results are T29 scope.
dependency_requests: Fixture owner (T05/T21 lane): generate committed F10 (missing/malformed ToUnicode) and F11 (duplicates) fixture families so later native suites consume repository fixtures instead of in-test synthesis; the T05 generator API already supports the recipes.

measured_decisions.decision: Occurrences are emitted at glyph-box granularity (consecutive identical loose charboxes coalesced)
measured_decisions.reason: PDFium's character API expands one glyph into several Unicode scalars that share one reported box; coalescing preserves the glyph-to-Unicode expansion as one position-bearing occurrence without inventing per-scalar widths, while duplicate glyphs at distinct positions stay distinct occurrences (I02).
measured_decisions.tradeoff: Text runs are split at every distinct glyph box; consumers join ordered occurrences (the tests rebuild the engine text exactly).

measured_decisions.decision: Physical geometry is derived from pypdf page metadata inside the PDFium adapter
measured_decisions.reason: Measured on this build: get_size() applies rotation but ignores UserUnit, exactly as recorded in planning/architecture/COORDINATES.md; the contract mandates metadata-based compensation. Crop box + /UserUnit feed the canonical transform C, applied once.

measured_decisions.decision: Normalized text is identity-mapped raw text with an identity normalization_map
measured_decisions.reason: Raw fidelity (I03) with the declared 'scalar-whitespace-v1' setting reserved; conservative normalization semantics belong to T12, and no digit/punctuation/sign transformation is performed here.

Mapping/control/covered actual outputs p.detail: mapping-amount expands glyph 0x31 to '1,0' (coalesced occurrence with the shared reported glyph box); mapping-control keeps identity '1' with the identical dollar box; covered-amount preserves PDFium's actual merged output '$1,00000' and pypdf's '$1,000$100' verbatim. No output was corrected or normalized away.

shared glyph boxes not split with guesse.detail: Consecutive characters reporting an exactly-equal loose charbox are coalesced into one occurrence carrying the full multi-scalar text; no width interpolation exists in the adapter (asserted: no standalone ',' occurrence, dollar box unchanged, basis documents the coalescing).

pypdf text stays page-only.detail: The pypdf adapter emits one occurrence per page with precision 'page_only', polygon null and empty transform_ids; no visitor matrices are read and no combining with PDFium boxes exists in either adapter.

all rotations/origins map correctly.detail: geometry-0/90/180/270 store identical canonical anchors for the '$' glyph (rotation is display-only), matching the analytic value (56, 2*(390-263.44)) from the negative-origin crop box at UserUnit 2; userunit-0.5/1/2/10 scale exactly once (physical dims 520u x 400u from pypdf metadata; PDFium get_size() measured UserUnit-blind and is not trusted).

malformed/encrypted failures isolated.detail: Empty/malformed bytes, digest mismatch and password-encrypted documents raise typed AdapterError('parser_error') at open; closed handles, out-of-range pages, wrong capability and region requests return terminal unsupported/failed CheckResults; cancellation is terminal; emission chunks are bounded at 256. No exception escapes with partial results.

build/version manifest complete..detail: Both manifests validate against the T03 JSON Schema ($defs/ReaderManifest, Draft 2020-12): adapter_version 1.0.0, engine build 'pypdfium2 5.8.0 / PDFium 149.0.7825.0', SHA-256 of the loaded PDFium native binary as model hash and asset hash, pypdf 6.18.0 distribution digest, capability support/limits, execution policy constant.
